description:
Download the files associated with the specified Document Revisions as a ZIP archive.

By default the response is a 302 redirect to a presigned ZIP URL in the Location header. Pass `no_redirect=true` to receive 200 `{ data: { download_url, url_expires_at } }` instead.

Document revisions without a file are silently omitted from the ZIP, so the archive may contain fewer files than IDs requested. `download_all_document_revisions` is currently disabled — an empty `document_revision_ids` list returns 400. At most 300 unique document revision IDs may be requested.

parameters.name: no_redirect
parameters.description: If this query parameter is set to true, the response will be an object containing the download URL.

200.description: If the `no_redirect=true` query parameter is provided, the response will be an object containing the download URL.

400.description:
Bad Request

Possible reason codes:
- MISSING_REQUIRED_PROPERTY
- INVALID_PROPERTY
- INVALID_BODY

404.description:
One or more document revision IDs were not found.

Possible reason codes:
- NOT_FOUND

413.description:
You can only download up to 300 documents at a time.

Possible reason codes:
- EXCEEDS_LIMIT

document_revision_ids.description: Array of Document Revision IDs to be included in the download. Must be empty if download_all_document_revisions is set to true.

download_all_document_revisions.description: If true, all document revisions that satisfy the filter params will be included in the download. If set to true, the document_revision_ids must be an empty array.
